baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثُلَّةٌ (ث ل ل) and ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ (ء خ ر).
baseline_models.mechanism: The partitive construction selects an assembled subset from people marked as after or other than an earlier set.

activation_trace.role: An assembled human group supplies the collective nucleus and makes the line a cohort statement.
Being after the first or being other supplies the cohort's temporal and relational horizon.

changed_reading.before: A flat count of many later people.
changed_reading.after: A bounded, assembled cohort drawn from those who come after or are other than the first.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The group noun ثُلَّةٌ is qualified by the rearward branch of ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The latter term can organize the group spatially as a contingent gathered from those behind or at the rear, without requiring a historical-generation reading.

activation_trace.role: The gathered-group image supplies a coherent contingent rather than isolated individuals.
The rear or back of a thing supplies a positional alternative to purely chronological laterness.

changed_reading.before: The verse refers only to people of a later era.
changed_reading.after: It can also picture a gathered contingent brought in from the rearward ranks.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact recurrence of the same group noun and partitive frame pairs a first cohort with a later cohort; firstness and succession make the latter a coordinate body rather than a residue.

activation_trace.role: The assembled-group image names the later member of the pair.
The after-first relation supplies the second pole of the contrast.
The identical assembled-group image supplies the formally matched first member.
Beginning and precedence establish the first cohort against which the focus cohort is paired.
One thing following another supplies sequential continuity between the first and later cohorts.

structural_cues: 56:39 and 56:40 repeat the same indefinite ثُلَّةٌ/min construction, with 56:40 joined by wa- and only the temporal classifier changed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact syntactic repetition plus first/later contrast; I infer parity of cohort category, not equal headcount, while the indefinite nouns leave relative sizes open.

changed_reading.before: A later contingent appears as an isolated afterthought.
changed_reading.after: The later group is the coordinated counterpart of the first group within one two-part population.

context_deltas.mechanism: Companionship, right-associated strength, and an ordered group by which a person gains strength turn the thulla from a headcount into a mutually sustaining constituency.

activation_trace.role: The assembled group is the focus anchor that receives the social-support mechanism.
Later or other people locate this sustaining body beyond the first cohort.
Companionship and abiding association make the beneficiaries a relational collective.
Right as strength and claim gives the associated collective full standing rather than secondary status.
A group through which one gains strength supplies the functional image of mutual reinforcement.

structural_cues: 56:27 opens by repeating the companions of the right, and 56:38 restates them immediately before the paired cohort lines.
The provision sequence repeatedly arranges separate items into ordered, supportive abundance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, right-strength, and a strength-conferring group; I transfer the nadd support image from arranged provision to the human thulla, while the live alternative keeps nadd wholly material.

changed_reading.before: The latter thulla is only a numerical demographic category.
changed_reading.after: It is also a later constituency whose members accompany and reinforce one another with full standing among the companions of the right.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deliberate re-creation and making into an untouched, equal-aged condition turn laterness into provenance before transformation, not an enduring rank inside the renewed cohort.

activation_trace.role: The assembled group supplies the collective that can share one renewed condition.
Temporal after-ness marks the cohort's origin before the equalizing transformation.
Bringing something newly into being supplies the renewal operation.
Making something assume a condition supplies directed transformation rather than passive chronology.
Untouched first-condition imagery supplies restored freshness.
Equality in age and companionship supplies the levelling result.

structural_cues: 56:35-37 form a creation-making-result sequence; 56:38 assigns its benefit to the companions of the right before 56:39-40 distribute those companions across first and later cohorts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies new creation, directed making, first-condition imagery, and age equality; I infer that this sequence can neutralize chronological rank in the population named next, while the pronouns may instead refer more narrowly to companions or rewards.

changed_reading.before: Being later implies a permanently secondary temporal status.
changed_reading.after: Laterness names provenance, while re-creation gathers the cohort into an equalized present condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of temporal extension, abundance, denied ending, and denied barrier activates the later cohort as evidence that access continues through time instead of being exhausted by the first cohort.

activation_trace.role: A substantial assembled group is the result that requires continued access.
Deferral to a later time supplies the temporal span across which access persists.
An extended duration supplies continuity into later time.
Numerical growth supplies abundance rather than a dwindling remainder.
Ending and disappearance, explicitly negated in the source, supply the interruption that is denied.
A barrier to what one seeks, explicitly negated in the source, supplies the exclusion that is denied.

structural_cues: 56:30-33 moves from extended and abundant provision to the coordinated negations 'not cut off' and 'not forbidden,' before the population formula in 56:38-40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuity and unobstructed abundance in the provision field; I map that pattern onto cohort access, while the materially live alternative confines every adjective to paradise goods.

changed_reading.before: The later group is merely whoever remains after the first.
changed_reading.after: Its substantial presence figures admission and provision as still open in later time, neither exhausted nor barred.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the soil-from-well-or-grave branch of ث ل ل and the dust branch behind أتراب rather than their surface senses; it remains anchored through the focus group root plus the packet's raising and creating sequence, but downstream prose should label it a resurrection-material analogy, not a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ثُلَّةٌ activates gathered well or grave earth, while ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ keeps the image attached to the later cohort.

activation_trace.role: Earth removed from or heaped around a well or grave supplies the material-reassembly image at the focus noun.
The later people retain the image's required population anchor.
Physical raising supplies upward recovery from the earth image.
New creation supplies reconstitution rather than mere excavation.
Earth and dust echo the material from which the gathered cohort is exploratorily reconstituted.

changed_reading.before: A group is counted among later people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a later cohort is pictured as earth gathered, raised, and newly reconstituted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the focus root's pouring-of-coins branch to poured water and abundance; the repeated discharge image remains focus-anchored and changes a static count into an influx, but it should be rendered only as a material analogy rather than as the lexical meaning of ثُلَّةٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ثُلَّةٌ carries a pouring branch, and ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ confines the resulting influx to the later people.

activation_trace.role: Pouring out coins supplies a discharged-plenitude image directly from the focus root.
The after-first relation fixes that outpouring to the later cohort.
Pouring and flowing repeat the focus root's discharge image in the immediate environment.
Growth in number makes the discharge an abundant influx rather than a sparse trickle.

changed_reading.before: The later cohort is a static quantity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it arrives as an abundant outpouring of later people.

strongest_changes: The exact 56:39-40 parallel makes the later thulla a coordinate cohort rather than a residual afterthought.
The 56:35-37 transformation sequence allows chronological lateness to become provenance before renewal into a coeval present.
Companionship, right-strength, and ordered mutual support recast the thulla as a sustaining body rather than a headcount.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two roots admit temporal, positional, material, and restorative activations; the immediate pericope repeatedly assembles, extends, removes barriers, creates, and equalizes, so laterness can become inclusion in a formed collective rather than mere chronology.
remaining_uncertainties: Parallel thulla labels establish categorical symmetry, not equal numerical size.
Creation and equal-age language may describe companions or rewards rather than transforming the cohorts themselves.
Continuity, earth-reassembly, and outpouring readings are cross-domain activations and should not be presented as lexical translations.
